created_by.product: ChatGPT Work Mode with GitHub connector

target_product: Gemini under Google AI Pro via human bridge
role: Google Ecosystem, Knowledge & Cloud Feasibility Architect
context_digest: The four consumer AI products are owned, but automatic access, API separation, quota, billing, data, and automation rights are not verified. Build the registry without enabling any service.
instructions: Read every listed artifact at the pinned commit. Produce docs/program/CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.md and docs/program/CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.json for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok. Separate consumer subscription from API entitlement. For each material capability record access path, mode, auth, plan evidence, incremental cost, billing requirement, quota and terms source, data policy, region, automation status, verification time, status, and fallback. Use only current official primary sources for current claims. Mark uncertain items UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/HUMAN_BRIDGE rather than inferring. Return one ResponsePacket for UJ-CAP-001 proposing REVIEW with accepted weight 0/13.

acceptance_criteria.text: All four primary AI products have explicit access paths and conservative provider modes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Provide an artifact path/hash and a concrete check for criterion 1.

acceptance_criteria.text: Subscription and API entitlement are separated for every provider.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Provide an artifact path/hash and a concrete check for criterion 2.

acceptance_criteria.text: Current claims carry official source and verification date; unknowns are not promoted.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Provide an artifact path/hash and a concrete check for criterion 3.

acceptance_criteria.text: Paid, billing-risk, UI-automation, and local-compute paths are disabled or blocked with fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Provide an artifact path/hash and a concrete check for criterion 4.

acceptance_criteria.text: ResponsePacket is valid, hashes artifacts, proposes REVIEW, and keeps accepted weight at 0/13.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Provide an artifact path/hash and a concrete check for criterion 5.

forbidden_actions: Use a paid or pay-per-use API.
Enable billing, create a billing account, or accept overage risk.
Automate a consumer UI, cookie, browser session, or login.
Run heavy model inference on Christian's computer.
Read, request, reveal, or store secret values.
Write directly to main, merge a pull request, deploy production, or create accounts.
Mark the task DONE or award accepted weight without the named independent reviewer.
Perform another primary AI's task or claim that another AI agrees without its packet.

return_channel.destination: Return artifact files and one ResponsePacket JSON to the ChatGPT ultraJARVIS integration session; use a review branch/PR only if GitHub write is actually available.
